ignores.fill-outline-color/multiply: one pixel at each outer corner of a 1-px outline: D3D's line rasterisation draws a segment's start pixel there, GL's does not
ignores.geojson/inline-linestring-fill: a self-intersecting ring filled: GL JS's earcut triangulates it differently from our ear clipping
